title: Ada and the Choir
author: Petra Fairweather
blurb: Casper Thackeray, a debt-bound temple scribe, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
